shortDescription: K+S XETR:SDF is not planning any production cuts despite concerns over winter gas supply in Germany, the salt and potash miner said on Wednesday."For 2026, we have already secured about 70 % of our gas need at a favourable price (for our German production)," K+S told Reuters.
